alcaz-prison.name: Alcaz Prison
alcaz-prison.note: New. One boss with kill-count objectives.

barrow-deeps.attunement: No quest chain. The Brooch of the Wardens appears in the files as an access item, but how you get it is unknown.
barrow-deeps.bossNote: Names from the game files (Legacy achievement list), not a confirmed fight order. Warcraft Tavern lists Deepscar Matriarch where the files show Chillhowl.
barrow-deeps.comp: Starting point: 2 tanks, 2–3 healers, 5–6 damage dealers.
barrow-deeps.entrance: Mount Hyjal. LFCarry reports two more entrances, one possibly through Blackmaw Hold.

mage.loot: Readable so far: Torch of Light (ilvl 65), Malleable Essence of Nature, Brooch of the Wardens and boss shards. Its 20 weapons are still sealed. Manaflare Regalia pieces are expected from the new raids.
mage.note: New 10-player raid. Opens 9 December. Encounter rows and weapons are still sealed in the files.

priest.loot: Tier pieces for Raiments of Conviction (Shadow) are expected from the new raids; which boss drops what isn't known.

warlock.loot: Demonheart Raiment pieces (found in the files)

barrow-deeps.name: Barrow Deeps
barrow-deeps.note: New 10-player raid with 8 bosses. Opens 9 December. Loot and encounter data are still sealed in the files.

priest.note: Essential: the quest here rewards Gravestone Scepter, a wand that boosts Shadow Word: Pain.

warlock.note: Essential: Gravestone Scepter from the quest, and Twilight cultists here drop the Soran'ruk fragments for the Warlock off-hand quest (Classic steps).

hyjal-summit.bossNote: Blizzard confirmed 13 bosses on 20 October, starting with an ancient guardian. The names are still a datamined roster (Conquest Capped, 7 October); Blizzard hasn't published them.
hyjal-summit.comp: Starting point: 2–3 tanks, 4–5 healers, the rest damage dealers. Blizzard calls it Forever's largest raid.
hyjal-summit.entrance: Mount Hyjal, a zone that was closed in Classic.

onyxia-s-lair.attunement: Classic-style quest chain, per character at launch. Start it as soon as you're in range so it doesn't hold up raid night.
onyxia-s-lair.comp: Starting point: 3–4 tanks, 10–12 healers, the rest damage dealers. The only 40-player raid until summer 2027.
